cases.proves_bugs: BUG-684 (CD Existing line on a polyline with an arc, and on a closed polyline: CE warns that the pipe is straight between the corners (curved sides) or without the closing side, and the drawn source line is kept; it is no longer erased)
cases.title: CD with E on a polyline with an arc, and on a closed polyline, warns in plain words that the pipe runs straight between the corners, makes the pipe and keeps your drawn line
cases.plan_item: CD Existing line (triage group N4; daily card D04 neighbour); BUG-684
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 25 Oct 2026 with BUG-684 in BUG_CARPARK.md (expected: arcs and closed polylines are refused or warned about and the source line is kept). The pipe's length and grade label are not compared with the arc length (a pipe on a curve is not drawn by CD); BUG-697 is R39.
cases.expected: A polyline drawn straight 150000,-99000 to 155000,-99000 then an arc to 160000,-97000, picked with CD, E, makes the New Pipe window open; after levels 18.000 / 17.800 and Start Pipe, CE has said "That line has curved sides" and a CE pipe object exists, and the drawn polyline is STILL in the drawing. The same for a closed 4-corner polyline (150000,-93000 / 154000,-93000 / 154000,-90000 / 150000,-90000, closed): CE says "That line is closed ..." and the drawn polyline is still in the drawing. The drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The pick of the drawn line, the warning and the erase or keep of the source line happen in a live CD run in the real drawing.
not_automated: That the pipe is straight between the corner points is not measured. BUG-697 (a plain line) is R39; BUG-187 and BUG-874 are not driven.
